request_field() {
    field_tail="$1"
    field_index="$2"
    case "$field_tail" in *'|'*) ;; *) printf '%s\n' "$field_tail"; return ;; esac
    while [ "$field_index" -gt 1 ]; do
        case "$field_tail" in *'|'*) field_tail="${field_tail#*'|'}" ;; *) printf '\n'; return ;; esac
        field_index=$((field_index - 1))
    done
    printf '%s\n' "${field_tail%%'|'*}"
}

        finish_request "$request" "${id:-invalid}" "${cmd:-invalid}" 1 invalid_request
        return $?

    CURRENT_REQUEST_CMD="$cmd"

        log_line "request claim failed id=$id cmd=$cmd; action not started"

init_request_state() {

    LAST_COMPLETED_REQUEST_ID=

        if [ "$current_request" = "$replay_request" ]; then

                TERMINAL_ACK_PENDING=0

                publish_pending_terminal_ack >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
            fi
        fi
    else

        fi

daemon.before:
oneshot_request() {
    trusted_id="${1:-}"
    trusted_sha256="${2:-}"
    [ "$(id -u 2>/dev/null)" = "0" ] || return 126
    timing_mark "${trusted_id:-invalid}" T4 unknown
    ensure_request_dirs || return 1
    if ! valid_request_id "$trusted_id" || ! valid_sha256 "$trusted_sha256"; then
        log_line "request kick rejected: invalid authenticated metadata"
        return 0
    fi
    captured_request="$(settings_get_clean "$REQ_TEXT_KEY")"
    [ -n "$captured_request" ] || return 0
    captured_id="$(request_field "$captured_request" 1)"
    captured_sha256="$(request_sha256 "$captured_request")" || {
        log_line "request kick rejected: sha256 unavailable"
        return 1
    }
    if [ "$captured_id" != "$trusted_id" ] || [ "$captured_sha256" != "$trusted_sha256" ]; then
        log_line "request kick rejected: authenticated payload mismatch id=$captured_id"
        return 0
    fi
    init_request_state "$captured_request"
    process_settings_request "$captured_request"
    result=$?
    trim_log
    return "$result"
}
